title: A Qualitative Study of User Perception of M365 AI Copilot

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews where users self-reported the AI's default to American English and its inability to accurately process non-native accents and specific dialects in speech-to-text functions.

Qualitative thematic analysis of user interviews highlighting the AI's limited cultural context, lack of cultural nuance, and prioritization of international sources over regionally relevant findings.
Qualitative analysis of user feedback capturing specific anecdotal instances where the AI generated stereotypical societal narratives (e.g., describing women as 'more caring and empathetic').
Qualitative interviews capturing user observations that the AI exhibited a clear preference for retrieving information from specific journal publishers and databases.
